name: Wego
description:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside Claude. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wego to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wego to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wego.com/claude-app/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Wego MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Wego scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wego MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wego provides these MCP tools: flights_poll, flights_search, hotels_poll, hotels_search, and places_find_location.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wego?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wego in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Wego does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Wego is developed by Wego Pte Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
